$comment: The `unsafe` tokens each registry dependency's source carries, across both Cargo workspaces (root and crates/fuzz) and every platform the lockfiles resolve, read by `cargo xtask unsafe-ledger` (QR-28c). The count is a lexer's: every `unsafe` keyword outside comments and literals, used or not, so it over-counts and measures arrival, not risk. Shrink-only: a count above its ceiling fails until the entry is raised BY HAND with its reason updated, after someone has read what arrived; a count below fails until `--update` banks it; a crate with unsafe and no entry, or an entry for a crate gone from the tree, fails. A reason says where the crate sits (shipped, build time, xtask, fuzz) and what the unsafe is for. Measured 2026-11-06.

arbitrary.reason: fuzz only (libfuzzer-sys's build or runtime), never shipped: structured-input derivation for fuzz targets

bitflags.reason: xtask only, never shipped: flag types under wasmparser

bumpalo.reason: build time only (inside a proc macro the wasm build runs), never in an artifact: arena allocator of wasm-bindgen-macro-support

cc.reason: build time only, never shipped: libfuzzer-sys's build (fuzz) and minicov's (wasm test harness): compiles libFuzzer's C++; process and job-server plumbing

chacha20.reason: tests only (through the whiteboard-proptest dev-dependency), never shipped: the ChaCha stream cipher behind rand's standard RNG; SIMD backends selected by CPU feature

core_detect.reason: tests only (through the whiteboard-proptest dev-dependency), never shipped: CPU feature detection (cpuid, xgetbv) for chacha20 under rand

cpufeatures.reason: tests only (through the whiteboard-proptest dev-dependency), never shipped: CPU feature detection for chacha20 under rand

futures-task.reason: wasm test harness only (wasm-bindgen-test, a wasm32 dev-dependency of the core crates for QR-21 layer 3), never shipped: waker plumbing under futures-util

libfuzzer-sys.reason: fuzz only (libfuzzer-sys's build or runtime), never shipped: the libFuzzer entry symbol and its FFI

nu-ansi-term.reason: wasm test harness only (wasm-bindgen-test, a wasm32 dev-dependency of the core crates for QR-21 layer 3), never shipped: colouring of the runner's output (Windows console FFI)

num-traits.reason: wasm test harness only (wasm-bindgen-test, a wasm32 dev-dependency of the core crates for QR-21 layer 3), never shipped: numeric traits under the harness's statistics

object.reason: xtask only, never shipped: zero-copy casts of header structs from file bytes (the Pod trait, alignment- and length-checked) and a read-cache lifetime transmute; harden-check reads ELF headers through it

pin-project-lite.reason: wasm test harness only (wasm-bindgen-test, a wasm32 dev-dependency of the core crates for QR-21 layer 3), never shipped: pin projection in futures-util and tokio

serde.reason: xtask only, never shipped: serde's derive and data model (also counts `unsafe` in generated-code templates)

serde_core.reason: xtask only, never shipped: serde's core traits

serde_json.reason: xtask only, never shipped: JSON reading of cargo metadata and the ledgers

shlex.reason: build time only, never shipped: libfuzzer-sys's build (fuzz) and minicov's (wasm test harness): shell-word splitting inside cc

wasm-bindgen-macro-support.reason: build time only (inside a proc macro the wasm build runs), never in an artifact: #[wasm_bindgen] expansion; mostly `unsafe` inside the code it GENERATES, which wasm-bindgen's count stands for

wasm-bindgen-test.reason: wasm test harness only (wasm-bindgen-test, a wasm32 dev-dependency of the core crates for QR-21 layer 3), never shipped: the harness itself: the test registry and panic hook it installs

windows-sys.reason: wasm test harness only (wasm-bindgen-test, a wasm32 dev-dependency of the core crates for QR-21 layer 3), never shipped: Windows API bindings, resolved for Windows targets under nu-ansi-term and winapi-util and built for no target here

zmij.reason: xtask only, never shipped: float formatting inside serde_json
